glycomics_matrix.csv.description: Continuous optical density (OD450) binding intensities of 155 CCRC monoclonal antibodies across 12 Arabidopsis root samples.

mAbs_CCRC-M*.description: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) binding signal for CCRC glycan-directed monoclonal antibody.

glycomics_metadata.csv.description: Sample annotations for the OSD-615 spaceflight experiment.

Sample_Name.description: Unique identifier for biological root sample.

Spaceflight.description: Experimental condition (ISS spaceflight vs KSC ground control).

Growth_Time.description: Harvest timepoint post-germination activation in Veggie hardware.

glycan_class_annotations.csv.description: Annotation mapping for all 155 monoclonal antibodies.

mAb.description: Monoclonal antibody accession identifier (e.g. CCRC-M138, JIM13).

Glycan_Class.description: Carbohydrate class (e.g. Xylan / Arabinoxylan, Xyloglucan, AGPs, HG Pectin).

Target_Epitope.description: Chemical structure and linkage of recognized glycan epitope.

rnaseq_cytoskeleton_degs.csv.description: Curated differential expression values for cytoskeletal motors and matrix enzymes.

Gene_Symbol.description: Standard gene symbol (e.g. MYA1, KIN12A, CESA4, SEC).

log2FC.description: Log2 fold change in spaceflight versus ground control.

FDR.description: Benjamini-Hochberg False Discovery Rate adjusted p-value.

Functional_Role.description: Mechanistic function in cytoskeletal transport or cell wall synthesis.

single_cell_predictions.json.description: Salk Institute single-cell foundation model spatial transcriptomics matrix across 14 root cell types.

microscopy_database.json.description: High-resolution microscopy, histology, and confocal IHC index from Nakashima et al. 2023 (PMC10444889).
